entries.title: Tropico

emulation.notes: Use the Windows PC release with compatibility fixes if needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation for a 2001 city-builder.

primary.version: Tropico Reloaded / Mucho Macho Edition route
primary.why: The Windows PC route is the best current way to play the original Tropico with Paradise Island included through bundle/re-release paths. The Mac OS X release is valid historically, but PC has the clearest current storefront and compatibility route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Tropico Reloaded on Windows PC through Steam or GOG for the original game, Paradise Island, and Tropico 2 in one package.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Windows PC release, now commonly accessed through Tropico Reloaded/Mucho Macho-style bundles with Paradise Island.
all_releases.reason: primary: best current complete and compatibility route.
skip: valid historical route, but Windows PC is the clearer current complete/capture path.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows PC has the clearest bundled route for the original plus Paradise Island.

entries.remaster_caveats: Paradise Island is expansion content for the original Tropico. Tropico Reloaded is a bundle, not a separate sequel.

entries.title: Tropico 3
entries.definitive_edition: Tropico 3: Gold Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC Gold Edition; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC Gold Edition is the best route because it includes the Absolute Power expansion and has the best capture/compatibility path. Xbox 360, macOS, iOS/iPadOS, and Android are valid access routes but do not add sourced exclusive content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Play Tropico 3: Gold Edition on Windows PC through Steam or GOG for the base game plus Absolute Power.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PC release, with Gold Edition bundling Absolute Power.
all_releases.reason: primary: best complete and capture route.
skip: valid console route, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Mac OS X Gold Edition route.
all_releases.reason: skip: useful native Mac route, but Windows PC remains the preferred capture/compatibility path.

all_releases.fidelity: Redesigned mobile adaptation released first for iPad, then iPhone.
all_releases.reason: skip: mobile access route, but not more complete than PC Gold Edition.
skip: mobile access route, but not more complete than PC Gold Edition.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: PC Gold Edition remains the complete and best capture route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Absolute Power is expansion content, not a separate mainline game. Tropico Mobile is a mobile adaptation of Tropico 3, not a separate sequel.

entries.title: Tropico 6

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Current PC release with DLC/mod route
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best Tropico 6 route because it has the full DLC path, ModKit support, mouse/keyboard controls, and the best capture/settings flexibility.
